source_summary: Horizontal Chinese landscape with misty distant mountains, a large green-washed hillside, willow and bamboo growth along water, riverside buildings, a scholar figure, fence, rocks, dense trees, and rippled water. Calligraphy, seals, signatures, borders, and paper texture are excluded from motifs.

motifs.name: distant_mist_mountains
motifs.description: Soft distant mountain range and pale misty shoreline on the left middle distance, isolated below the inscription area; include only the washed peaks, low banks, and atmospheric gaps.
must_preserve: subtle layered depth without hard outlines

motifs.name: main_rolling_hillside
motifs.description: Broad rolling hillside spanning the upper center and right, with rounded ridges, green mineral wash, scattered dark rock and shrub marks, and receding peak forms.
must_preserve: dark broken ink dabs for rocks and shrubs

motifs.name: left_willow_marsh_stream
motifs.description: Dense willow and reed marsh at lower left with bending leaf strokes, small exposed rocks, and a shallow stream course running through the vegetation.

motifs.name: central_bamboo_tree_clump
motifs.description: Central grove of bamboo, shrubs, and two pale tree trunks rising before the hillside, including the clustered leaves and bamboo arcs but excluding nearby buildings.

motifs.name: riverside_house_scholar
motifs.description: Main riverside house with rectangular walls, sloped roof, barred windows and doorway, plus the small seated scholar figure at the right side of the structure.
must_preserve: light grey roof wash and dark base accents

motifs.name: fence_rock_embankment
motifs.description: Low wooden fence and rocky embankment along the water below the house, including posts, rails, rough stones, and the narrow bank edge.
must_preserve: rounded rock blocks with wash shadows

motifs.name: right_forest_screen
motifs.description: Dense vertical screen of trees on the right side, including pines, bare trunks, leafy shrubs, and dark foliage masses; isolate the tree growth from the buildings beneath.
must_preserve: vertical rhythm of trunks and shrubs

motifs.name: lower_right_waterside_pavilion_willow
motifs.description: Small lower-right waterside pavilion partly hidden by trees, with triangular roof, light walls, adjacent willow branches, rocks, and nearby shallow water.
must_preserve: pale water wash and bank transition

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
